messages:
alex_sales: Demo with OrionTech just failed. Customer says the assistant cut off mid-note. They uploaded a single JSON ~460KB and got a 413 from our endpoint. Need quick workaround, demo in 90m.

devon_se: 413 implies gateway/client max body size somewhere. Also large payload -> may exceed model context (which for gpt-redwood-compat-3.x is 32k tokens).

alex_sales: They used our demo API URL. curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @big_notes.json and got HTTP/1.1 413.

priya_sre: Can you paste response headers? Our demo nginx default is client_max_body_size 1m so 460KB should pass. Could be customer proxy or CDN. Tagging infra to check edge logs.

jordan_se: Even if 413 goes away, 460KB of UTF-8 text could map to >40k tokens, so truncation during encode is likely. Recommend chunking client-side and stitching summaries.

emma_ae: Customer UX wants single upload. Any fast alternatives?

jordan_se: Options (fast):
- Client chunking by paragraphs/timestamps, generate per-chunk summaries, then final merge prompt.
- Presign + store the file in S3 and have our POC lambda fetch/stream it so we don't send full body through edge (needs short dev work).
- Quick op change: bump demo proxy limit to 5m for this tenant only (ops risk).

alex_sales: Which is fastest to enable for a 90m demo?

priya_sre: Fastest is client chunking. Ops change takes 30-60m plus rollback risk. Presign + fetcher needs engineering.

devon_se: I can provide a minimal chunking snippet and prompt templates. Keep chunk size to ~8-12k tokens (~70-100k chars depending) and avoid overlapping content to reduce token spend. Use stream=true to show progress.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: spike of 413s observed from edge us-east-1 at 2026-02-14T15:22. Ticket INF-4890 opened.

alex_sales: I'll ask the customer to try chunking for the demo and share a sample file for token estimates. If they refuse, we'll escalate presign path.

emma_ae: Buyer asked about costs: if we stitch server-side, they worry about extra token usage. How to explain?

devon_se: Explain it's additive: per-chunk requests + final merge tokens. Recommend a summarized merge prompt to minimize final tokens. Offer to run a quick token estimate on a sample.

alex_sales: they sent a 8k-word excerpt to me. DMing to devon now. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jordan_se: Actions: devon = chunking snippets + templates, priya = confirm edge logs + INF-4890, alex = coordinate with customer. Reopen thread if 413 persists.
